thread:
Sam: PTAL — I addressed the review comments from earlier. Split the change into two commits (refactor + tests), added a short changelog entry, and noted rollout steps in the PR description: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/421. Need one approving review and a merge-ops slot for canary. @Maria @Jin
Maria: skimmed — looks good overall. left a tiny nit about the log wording but not blocking. do you want squashed commits or keep as-is for bisectability? :thinking_face:
Sam: I intentionally kept separate commits to make bisects easier. If merge-ops requires a single commit for the release branch I can squash before merge, otherwise prefer to keep history. added a note in PR describing why.
Jin: quick question: did you change the default batching size? the diff shows a default of 64 which could affect latency for smaller requests.
Sam: good catch — the refactor accidentally bumped the default. restored the old default and made it configurable. snippet in the PR: ```diff
- BATCH_DEFAULT = 64
+ BATCH_DEFAULT = 32  # restored default, make configurable via env RUNTIME_BATCH_DEFAULT
```
Maria: thanks — that addresses my concern. :thumbsup: CI is green for unit tests but e2e had one flaky failure on the first run.
ci-bot: reran e2e (job #712) — all tests passed on retry.
Oliver: I can pick a canary slot tomorrow morning (2024-10-02 09:00 PT). I'll merge after CI stays green for 10m and no regressions show up in canary. do you want me to squash when merging?
Sam: if it's blocking the canary slot, go ahead and squash. otherwise no need. I've updated the PR description to call out the migration step and rollback plan.
Maria: LGTM assuming e2e stay stable. one-line nit fixed and pushed, PTAL again when you have a sec.
Sam: pushed the nit fix, force-pushed. thanks everyone! PTAL — re-requesting review @Maria @Jin
Jin: eyeballing now, looks fine. approved.
Maria: approved.
Oliver: merging into canary slot now, will monitor. :rocket:
Sam: thanks — leaving a note in the rollout doc with the canary watchlist metrics.
text: PTAL — addressed comments, requested one approve and merge ops slot
